create.name: Fernando Albert
create.bio:
Fernando Albert, known to students as Fer, is a psychic medium, Reiki teacher and meditation guide who lives and works in Galicia, in north-west Spain. He has been giving readings and teaching since 2012, working in English and Spanish and also speaking Galician and Catalan. His training includes Usui Reiki to master-teacher level, Karuna Reiki, advanced mediumship with the Lisa Williams International School, shamanic journeying and soul retrieval. He began recording guided meditations after a friend who was both a shaman and a voice coach encouraged him, and he has since made more than a hundred and fifty, many of them inspired by his spirit guides.

His teaching is plain-spoken and step by step, aimed at helping people build their own intuition rather than lean on his. Through his website, Meditate with Fernando, he sells short video courses on spirit guides, the Akashic records, the Hermetic principles, astral travel and channelling, along with readings and monthly mentoring by video call and chat. His YouTube channel, Your Daily Dose of Light, carries explainers on scrying, runes, sigils, sacred geometry and the tarot, plus monthly tarot messages. He has led live meditations and workshops in California, France and Spain, and offers group sessions and classes in person in Galicia on request.

courses.title: Spirit Guides Course
courses.description: A self-paced video course on getting to know your spirit guides and building a steady everyday relationship with them, with exercises to practise between lessons.

courses.title: Akashic Records Online Course
courses.description: A short video course that teaches a method for opening and reading your own Akashic records, with practice tasks along the way.

courses.title: Hermetic Principles Explained
courses.description: A video course that goes through the seven principles set out in the Kybalion one at a time and suggests ways to work with each in daily life.

courses.title: Learn Astral Travel
courses.description: A video course on astral projection drawn from his own experience, which he has had since childhood alongside lucid dreaming. It covers preparation, techniques and what to expect.

courses.title: Reiki Fundamentals
courses.description: A manual covering Usui Reiki from level one to master level, including the symbols and hand positions, with his own added technique. Attunements are sold separately for those who want to go further.

courses.title: Talk to Fer Monthly Mentoring
courses.description: A month of spiritual mentoring that starts with a thirty-minute reading by Zoom and continues with a month of WhatsApp chat with him.

courses.title: Little Psychic Reading
courses.description: A five-minute recorded reading in which he draws on his guides and other sources to answer your question. Longer readings are also available in his shop.

courses.title: Despertar y Conectar Con Tus Guías
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course in Spanish on waking up to your spirit guides and building a connection with them.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Fernando Albert on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations and short talks in English and Spanish on spirit guides, the chakras and everyday spirituality, including his series Your Daily Dose of Light. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Free Akashic Records Meditation
free_resources.description: A guided meditation of about ten minutes that takes you on an inner visit to your Akashic records. It is sent free by email when you join his mailing list.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 4.4k (profile, 31 Oct 2026); Instagram 8,236 (og:description, 31 Oct 2026); YouTube 1.11K (channel page, 31 Oct 2026); Facebook and X counts not readable without login → ~14k total → local_hero
flags: Works in English and Spanish about equally: roughly half his YouTube uploads and both Insight Timer courses are in Spanish.
Much of his business is paid psychic readings (his site cites 14,000+ Fiverr reviews); he does teach (courses, Reiki, meditations), but a human may want to weigh how much is readings.

Availability set to local_online (Lugo, Spain): his 'Spiritual services in Spain' page offers in-person group meditations, classes and workshops in north-west Spain, but on request rather than on a fixed schedule; the lead had in_person false.
His site calls him an author, but no book in his name was found on Amazon (only short ebooks on Tutorialspoint); no books listed.

His shop and site carry healing framing (distance healing list, theta and subliminal healing meditations, 'Meditation for ADHD' and 'Healing' categories, expulsion of hostile astral beings); none of those items are in the plan.
Course prices of $15 USD appear to be his standard shop prices (no sale marker found); check before going live.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; bio check relied mainly on his own site pages.
left_out: Energy healings (Basic Healing, Complete Healing), pet daily healing, soul retrieval and shamanic initiation ceremonies: healing framing or ceremonies sold on emotional and physical wellbeing.
Transformation and research packages ($1,500–$3,000): high-ticket coaching with little public detail.
The Conspiracy Tarot deck: sold on his site; no Amazon ASIN verified.
Free weekly distance healing list: healing framing.
Insight Timer course Expande tus Chakras y tu Vida en 10 Días: not chosen (Spanish; same topic as his chakra course).
YouTube: monthly tarot forecasts (dated), sub-2-minute promo clips, Spanish duplicates of the English explainers and the platonic love video left out.
Insight Timer tracks not listed individually.
